blocks.text: We have collected tons of testimonials and previously it was a bit fiddly having to log in, make a graphic, copy it etc etc, meant that most testimonials just became digital dust. This extension solves all that, if we need a quick social media post, want to add proof to an email or use as ads, we can just pick right from the extension, love it. They're like our very own social proof emojis now!
